main.summary: A page of catalog item identities that are pending deletion.

property.name: Items
property.summary: Pending-delete item identities in item-ID order.

property.name: NextAfterItemID
property.summary: Exclusive continuation key for the next page, or null when no more items remain.

constructor.name: CatalogPendingDeletePage
constructor.summary: Creates a pending-delete page and its optional continuation key.
constructor.param: Continuation key for the next page, or null.
